description: This file defines an immutable class ImmutableLabel implementing the Label interface. It provides methods to create label instances with validation, as well as overrides for standard methods such as equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: ImmutableLabel
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Label interface representing a string label with validation and standard object methods overridden.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a Label instance from a CharSequence, validating the input.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the label string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the label string.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the label's string value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the label's string value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string value of the label.
